result.stdout:
USAGE:
    slugger [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    slugger --theme docker --count 3
    slugger --ascii --max-length 63 --oneshot
    slugger --analyze ./my-theme.json --max-length 63
    slugger --register ./my-theme.json

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                              Prints help information
    -v, --version                           Prints version information
        --theme <NAME>                      Theme to draw from (default:
                                            slugger). Repeatable or
                                            comma-separated; '*' for every theme
                                            available
        --theme-dir <PATH>                  Where registered themes live
                                            (default: ~/.slugger/themes)
        --sep <CHARACTER>                   What joins the terms, whatever the
                                            casing. A single character, or ""
                                            for nothing (default: the casing's
                                            own: - for kebab, _ for snake and
                                            constant, nothing for camel and
                                            pascal)
        --word-sep <CHARACTER>              What joins the words of a multi-word
                                            term. A single character, or "" to
                                            glue them (default: the separator)
        --casing <CASING>                   kebab, snake, camel, constant or
                                            pascal (default: kebab). Sets the
                                            capitals, and what joins the terms
                                            unless --sep says otherwise
        --segment <MODE>                    What precedes the noun: adjective,
                                            participle, either, both or
                                            threeOrTwo (default: both).
                                            partici
